canDoYue: 你識喺睇樓時問月租同水電，如果今日決定就簽租約同付代理費，睇書面通知先交按金。
canDoEn: On a viewing, ask about the rent and utilities, sign the lease and pay the agency fee if you decide today, and read the written notice before the deposit.

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: Good morning. Let me show you this furnished flat.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。我帶你睇呢間有傢俬嘅單位。
dialogue.say: Good morning. Let me show you this furnished flat.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How much is the rent here, please, and are the utilities included?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢度月租幾多，唔該，水電包唔包？
dialogue.say: How much is the rent here, please, and are the utilities included?

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: The monthly rent is eighteen thousand dollars, and water is included.
dialogue.glossYue: 租金係一萬八千蚊，水費包咗。
dialogue.say: The monthly rent is eighteen thousand dollars, and water is included.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If I decide today, is the deposit one month's rent?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我今日決定，按金係咪一個月租金？
dialogue.say: If I decide today, is the deposit one month's rent?

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: The deposit is one month, and the rent stays fixed if you sign.
dialogue.glossYue: 按金係一個月，如果你簽租約，月租就維持不變。
dialogue.say: The deposit is one month, and the rent stays fixed if you sign.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will sign the lease and pay the agency fee this afternoon.
dialogue.glossYue: 我下晝會簽租約，同埋付代理費。
dialogue.say: I will sign the lease and pay the agency fee this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: lea
dialogue.text: Once you sign the lease, the landlord will give you the keys.
dialogue.glossYue: 你簽咗租約，業主就交鎖匙畀你。
dialogue.say: Once you sign the lease, the landlord will give you the keys.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will read the written notice carefully before I pay the deposit.
dialogue.glossYue: 我交按金之前會小心睇份書面通知。
dialogue.say: I will read the written notice carefully before I pay the deposit.
